Read anywhere

The complete supplied collection is included on your Mac. Save it in this browser as well to read and look up words even when the local server is closed.

On iPhone: a reachable HTTPS address is required; this Mac’s localhost address does not work on the phone. Open that HTTPS address in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen → Open as Web App. Then open Lectio from its home-screen icon.
